correctness.rationale: Independently generated all 16 edges of P6 square K2 and exhaustively enumerated its 732 nonempty matching faces, f-vector (16,92,234,263,114,13). Replayed the natural staged greedy Hasse matching: exactly 363 matched covers and one critical vertex plus five critical 3-faces, with topological-sort acyclicity on all 2,586 directed face-cover incidences. Forman gives wedge^5 S^3. Independently enumerated all fixed oriented simplices under row flip h, column reversal v and hv; signed chain traces yielded Lefschetz (-4,2,0,-2), hence H3 character (5,-1,1,3), irreducible multiplicities (2,0,1,2). Graph corners force exactly four automorphisms. These are complete finite exhaustions, not extrapolation beyond six rungs.

originality.rationale: Matsushita covers the nonequivariant six-rung wedge homotopy type as a specialization of the two-row grid recursion; it cannot determine how the two reflections act on homology. Li studies graded permutation representations ON MATCHINGS and its equivariant log-concavity, not the homology representation. The full V4 character is an additional exact natural invariant computed by signed orientation traces. Resultary exact-object query returned the current record as self and nearby graph invariants but no earlier table. The finding does not claim original homotopy theory or a ladder-length family theorem.
residual_risks: The ordinary homotopy type is completely covered by Matsushita; treating wedge^5 S3 as novel would fail originality.
A precomputed six-rung equivariant table or a simple implicit formula in unindexed literature could remove the narrowly claimed new character.
Result concerns rational representation and does not determine integral C2xC2 lattice or a recurrence for every ladder length.
